page_title: AI startup Artisan raises $2.3M to develop human-like digital workers

summary.name: Artisan
summary.one_liner: A news article announcing AI startup Artisan's $2.3M pre-seed raise to build "digital workers" called Artisans, starting with Ava, an AI sales representative.
use_cases: Learning about AI digital workers for sales teams
Following Artisan's product launch and roadmap
Background reading on AI agents in business
summary.what_it_does: The article reports that Artisan has raised $2.3 million to build AI "digital workers" called Artisans, which are designed to join teams as members rather than act as software tools that need constant human management. The first Artisan, Ava, is a sales representative that currently automates the full outbound sales cycle, with plans to expand to the entire sales cycle and act as a co-pilot for humans. The company says it plans to release five more Artisans in the following year. The article also covers the founders (a 22-year-old CEO and a CTO with an Oxford astrophysics PhD) and says the company will join Y Combinator's Winter 2024 batch.
notable: AI 'digital workers' positioned as team members rather than software tools
First worker Ava is an AI sales representative handling outbound sales
Plans for five more Artisans in the following year
caveats: Product was not yet launched at article time; Ava was scheduled to launch December 4th
Article is a funding announcement, so product details and pricing are limited
Full sales cycle automation is described as a future capability
